title: Aubrey Marcus had a DMT experience during a darkness retreat

tellings.quote: >> this wasn't like DMT. This was a DMT. I had a DMT experience whilst you know after the fourth or fifth day in in this darkness retreat.

plain: After four or five days in a darkness retreat, days spent in total darkness, a man named Aubrey Marcus says he had a full experience of DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound, without taking anything. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies DMT, passes on Marcus's words: "this wasn't like DMT. This was a DMT" experience. If true, it would suggest the body can make enough of the substance on its own to produce the trip.
